title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Terms, Clause 9 — Termination
content:
**9.1 Termination by the company.** The company may terminate its agreement under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements at any time by giving notice. The termination takes effect the tier's termination notice, in calendar days, after the notice date, or on the notice date itself when the tier's termination notice is zero. Only the company's authorized representative can confirm the termination.

**9.2 Termination by Crestline.** Crestline terminates an agreement only through the billing rule or the agreement-year tier review, never at a support agent's discretion.

**9.3 Effects of termination.** On termination:

- the roster closes;
- remaining points stay redeemable for the tier's post-termination redemption period, in calendar days;
- open invoices remain payable;
- tickets already booked keep their corporate benefits through travel.

### Notice dates (hypothetical)

| Notice given on | Tier's termination notice | Termination takes effect |
|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 0 calendar days | 1 April |
| 1 April | 60 calendar days | 31 May |
| 1 April | 90 calendar days | 30 June |

### Points of reading

- The notice runs in calendar days from the notice date; it is not rounded to the end of a month or of the agreement term.
- A request from someone who is not the company's authorized representative does not confirm a termination.
- Crestline's own terminations of an agreement come only from the billing rule or the tier review.
